title: Complete Arched Open Watercourse Span
description: One newly authored complete static classical arched-watercourse span. A single grounded stone core contains two broad piers, a fully open curved arch soffit, solid filled spandrels and the entire straight horizontal channel floor. Two complete thick raised sidewalls sit on finite opposed deck patches to form a genuinely open U-shaped upper channel with two open longitudinal ends. The lower arch passage crosses perpendicular to that upper channel, producing two real separated open-space levels. Not a copied exposed voussoir arch with a reused tray placed on it, not a gate with its mechanism removed, and not a longer ordinary bridge. Three closed editable meshes and three opaque constant stone PBR values; one modular asset, zero scenes. Static illustrative geometry only: no flowing water, hydraulic capacity, slope/drop, historical reconstruction, structural load, stability, navigation, public safety or neighbor-snap compatibility claim. Metres, native Z up, horizontally centred, two finite ground soles.
